newsitem.title: USA: Computer Sciences wins $35 million contract.
newsitem.headline: Computer Sciences wins $35 million contract.

text.p: Computer Sciences Corp said it had won a $35 million contract to operate the Central Satellite Data Processing Center of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration in Suitland, Md.
The computer said the eight-year contract has a base year valued at $4.3 million and seven one-year options, with a total value of $35 million if all options are exercised.
The contract also includes the capacity to acquire an additional $35 million in incidental hardware, software, software licenses, and software development over its eight-year duration, it said.

The Satellite Data Processing Center receives and processes real-time environmental satellite data from the adminstration's polar and geostationary satellites, the Department of Defense's Defense Meteorologic Satellites, the European METEOSAT and ERS-2 spacecraft and the Japanese GMS and ADEOS satellites.
